title: Grid-agnostic volume of fluid approach with interface sharpening and surface tension for compressible multiphase flows
summary: The interfacial diffusion associated with finite volume method (FVM) discretizations of multiphase flows creates the need for an interface sharpening mechanism. Such solutions for structured quadrilateral grids are well documented, but various engineering applications require mesh designs specific to the irregular geometry of the physical system it is modeling. Therefore this study casts interface sharpening as an ant-idiffusive volumetric body force whose calculation procedure is generalizable to an arbitrarily constructed grid.
